claim: What the Family Shares: the loop holds wavetable and waveguide together — 'a cycle read from a table and the same cycle going round a delay loop match sample for sample when the period is a whole number of samples'; the crowd holds partials, grains, neurons and birds; the wiring holds subtractive, FM and modular. And FM: 'past about 20 Hz a vibrato stops being heard as motion and turns into new partials'.

pieces.what: One stored cycle played two ways — read from a table, and circulating in a delay loop — with a null-test meter reading zero at an integer period; then add loss to the loop and it becomes a plucked string.

pieces.section: FM — the wiring, at audio rate
pieces.what: A vibrato whose rate you sweep from 2 Hz to 200 Hz with a live spectrum: hear motion turn into sidebands near 20 Hz and see them land at carrier plus and minus multiples of the modulator.
pieces.walks_up_from: a slow vibrato on one sine

pieces.section: Additive and modal — the crowd, of partials
pieces.what: Sum voices one at a time — partials, then grains — until the sum holds still; a counter of voices against a stability readout.

What a preset has to carry: the same sound saved as a knob list for a fixed topology and as cables-plus-knobs for a drawn one, sizes side by side — the page's own test for locating an instrument on the axis.
